items: ==GatewayClass== = infra kind; Gateway = listener + its TLS
Platform team owns the Gateway, app teams own **Routes**
HTTPRoute, GRPCRoute, TCPRoute: typed CRDs, not annotations
Cross-namespace attach needs an explicit ReferenceGrant

blocks.note: canary is spec, not an annotation

blocks.title: Ingress, Gateway Or Mesh
blocks.text: Ingress stays supported; new build-outs go Gateway API. A mesh adds mTLS, retries and observability east-west — don't add one for routing Ingress already covers.

caption.text: Part 3 of K8S NETWORKING HANDBOOK. Your Pod IP changed and half your traffic vanished — that is the exact problem every layer of Kubernetes networking exists to solve. Ten pages tracing one request end to end: ClusterIP virtual IPs and the kube-proxy datapath, NodePort SNAT traps, LoadBalancer bills, CoreDNS ndots tax, headless StatefulSet identity, Ingress TLS chains, and Gateway API. Save it for the next 502 you cannot explain.
